items.Sentence: The wastewater treatment process consists of screening, grit removal, seven sequencing batch reactors (activated sludge/secondary clarification), flow equalization, rapid mix/flocculation, filtration, chlorination and dechlorination.

Waste activated sludge is conveyed to three aerobic digesters and dewatered prior to disposal.
Digested sludge is dewatered with a centrifuge and the sludge cake (Class B Biosolids) is delivered directly to a local composting facility.
The Facility can also utilize on-site lined drying beds as a secondary method of dewatering.
